title: Five ratcheted remediation waves for compatibility, observability, cycles, and evaluation confidence
summary: Deliver R-0006 as five ordered waves that establish a preserved baseline and quick-only review policy, ratchet CPython compatibility before tests or mutation, expose graph/CLI/CI truth, land an import-cycle bound before four edge cuts, and add bounded repeated evaluation plus incomplete-work and seeded-failure evidence while deferring every wave-six architecture and security bet.

alternatives.name: Independent patches in one merge
alternatives.description: Patch the parse error, warning, CI call, deferred imports, and eval flags independently without cross-wave evidence contracts or an enforced landing sequence.

costs: Cannot prove the cycle ratchet preceded the cuts
Allows local green, degraded graph, and quick-to-deep drift to be misreported
Repeats the register's observed defect-regeneration pattern
tradeoffs.revisit_when: R-0006 is narrowed to one isolated defect with no sequencing, graph, exact-SHA, sampling, or review-depth acceptance criteria.

alternatives.name: Five contract-ratcheted waves
alternatives.description: Extend incumbent preflight, graph, CLI, review, evaluation, Retro, dashboard, and CI seams; add each quality gate before dependent changes; introduce only focused graph-primitives and evaluation-sampling modules.

gains: Each later wave is protected by already-landed executable gates
Wave-local rollback and exact acceptance traceability
Keeps package/schema/security redesign outside the release-blocking repair
costs: Requires multiple ordered commits and additive records
Live sampling costs an explicit bounded number of model calls
Ratchet and impact-map expectations become maintained artifacts
tradeoffs.revisit_when: All five waves are green and a separately approved wave-six requirement settles package, component, schema, identity, and trust-boundary changes.

alternatives.name: Broad architecture and security redesign first
alternatives.description: Move packages, centralize schemas, and change identity/attestation/isolation before repairing the registered defects.

gains: Could eliminate more cycles and reduce a later migration
costs: Mixes high-risk redesign with a release-blocking parse failure
Requires product and security decisions absent from R-0006
tradeoffs.revisit_when: A separate wave-six Design Contract is approved after R-0006's compatibility, visibility, cycle, corpus, and evaluation ratchets pass.

decision: Select five contract-ratcheted waves because this is the smallest approach that can prove ordering and prevent recurrence: baseline and quick-only authority first; compile/import before tests or mutation; structured graph/CLI/CI truth before pushed-green claims; a measured SCC ratchet in an earlier commit before explicit-input cuts; then bounded trials, completeness fixtures, selective corpus edges, and one catch-rate record. It reuses existing owners and adds four focused product modules plus explicit policy data.

contracts.description: CPython 3.10-3.13 is compiled and import-smoked before tests; stage dependency incompatibility becomes one named pre-mutation refusal.
R-0006 manifests contain quick sweep slots only; substantive quick findings return to correction with no promotion.
Graph quality, exact-SHA CI state, evaluation samples, and seeded-failure metrics share canonical records across machine/text/Markdown/dashboard projections.
Canonical live|unproven|advisory status binds evidence/session ids and hook-path receipt; only live is enforced, while attributable advisory never masquerades as live.
Local green is distinct from pushed green; only zero-ahead exact-SHA required-check evidence authorizes the latter label.

acceptance_map.validation: Resolve the canonical locator/project knowledge root and require a trusted pre-cleanup closed path/bytes/digest manifest; reject wrong/empty root, missing/moved/unexpected/non-lock entries, manifest-digest mismatch, stale Plan pointer, or prior Git blob drift. risks.risk: A wrong or emptied knowledge tree hashes successfully and falsely proves preservation.
risks.mitigation: Resolve the root only from canonical locator/project identity and require a trusted pre-cleanup closed relative-path/bytes/digest manifest; reject root mismatch, empty substitution, missing/moved/unexpected entries, and manifest mismatch.

risks.risk: Unproven hook enforcement is presented as live or silently treated as sufficient.
risks.mitigation: Use only live|unproven|advisory with evidence/session/hook-path receipt; reserve enforced for live, block unproven mutations, and require actor/reason/scope/expiry for visibly advisory continuation.

risks.risk: Baseline preservation is misread as keeping the new R-0006 working Design byte-identical to R-0004.
risks.mitigation: Bind preservation to immutable prior Git blobs and trusted pre-cleanup knowledge manifest; identify R-0006 as a later proposed artifact.

risks.risk: Eager compatibility probing mutates bytecode or runtime state before refusal.
risks.mitigation: Import at module startup before RunStore construction, set isolated no-bytecode fixtures, and byte-compare every governed store on failure.

risks.risk: Only decomposition reports bad Python, so base scans remain falsely complete.
risks.mitigation: Make base depgraph parsing emit per-file producer failures independently; combine decomposition additively and test strict/normal modes with decompose off and on.

risks.risk: Known CLI error mapping hides unexpected defects.
risks.mitigation: Use a closed enumerated table only for known engine classes; unexpected exceptions retain exit 70 and traceback, debug always re-raises.

risks.risk: Cycle expectations are updated to bless growth or copied from stale report estimates.
risks.mitigation: Generate with one checked-in scanner, require exact revision/member/edge/LOC evidence, allow shrinkage automatically, and require new approved Design for any upward bound.

risks.risk: Explicit input inversion silently drops context/impact or breaks direct decompose scans.
risks.mitigation: Use named tp/review/loop/retro composition edges, audit every governed caller, require direct scan(decompose=True) goldens, and allow sparse fallback only with proven sparse quality; no global registry.

risks.risk: Repeated trials duplicate spend or report a partial sample as a rate.
risks.mitigation: Bound repeats 1-100, key immutable trials by sample/scenario/observed-model/index, reuse exact retries only, and refuse incomplete/duplicate sets.

risks.risk: A broad eval impact mapping turns every engine change into a corpus blast radius.
risks.mitigation: Allow canonical corpus prefixes and exact tracked files only with row/total bounds; reject wildcards/directories/escapes and test unrelated product, CLI, and reporting files.

risks.risk: Seeded catch-rate double-counts repeats or is interpreted as production reliability.
risks.mitigation: Count unique scenario/failure/model/version/trial/revision units, enforce sample_size=denominator and duplicate rejection, hard-code the bounded label, and omit numeric fields when zero-sample unavailable.

risks.risk: Quick-only becomes silent acceptance when a finding would normally promote.
risks.mitigation: Promotion resolver returns correction/block, collection rejects deep slots, and a seeded substantive quick finding proves no deep worker is created.

failure_modes.mode: Authoritative knowledge preservation cannot be proven
failure_modes.detection: baseline_verification signal reports canonical root mismatch, absent/untrusted pre-cleanup manifest, empty substitution, or missing/moved/unexpected/byte/digest entry delta.
failure_modes.recovery: The orchestrator stops wave 1; baseline owner supplies the retained immutable closed manifest or restores the exact canonical evidence. If none exists, preservation remains unproven and cannot be reconstructed or waived as a pass.

failure_modes.detection: enforcement_status signal reports status, evidence/session ids, hook-path receipt, and any advisory authorization fields.
failure_modes.recovery: Host owner establishes a live verified hook receipt before mutation, or a human records actor/reason/exact wave scope/expiry to continue visibly advisory; nobody may label it enforced.

failure_modes.mode: Unsupported syntax, incomplete tracked compile set, or stage dependency import failure
failure_modes.detection: python_compatibility signal names interpreter, exact tracked-file-set fingerprint, closed stage-consumer set, module, phase=startup, and TaskplaneCompatibilityError before a store opens.
failure_modes.recovery: Runtime/CI maintainer fixes source or enumeration and reruns all four exact-file compile/import legs including outside-directory sentinel; no governed mutation is replayed because none occurred.

failure_modes.mode: Base scan or decomposition producer is degraded
failure_modes.detection: graph_scan_quality signal has degraded=true with producer, file/module/parser/reason and scanned SHA independent of decompose mode.
failure_modes.recovery: Graph maintainer repairs the named source/producer and rescans both modes; normal users retain honest fail-open output while strict readiness/review stays blocked until every producer is complete.

failure_modes.mode: Public CLI error registry drifts or an unexpected exception is swallowed
failure_modes.detection: cli_error_envelope signal/test reports registry/KNOWN set delta or unexpected-exception behavior mismatch.
failure_modes.recovery: CLI owner restores one registry-derived exact set or unexpected exit-70 traceback behavior and reruns normal/debug/unexpected fixtures before merge.

failure_modes.mode: Green evidence belongs to an ahead, behind, diverged, stale, or different SHA
failure_modes.detection: ci_commit_proof signal shows HEAD/origin/main/checked_sha inequality, ahead_count or behind_count nonzero, or missing/failing/mismatched receipt.
failure_modes.recovery: Release owner fetches, reconciles to the intended exact commit, waits for all checks on that SHA, and regenerates proof; no prior record is relabelled.

failure_modes.mode: An SCC gains a member, edge, LOC, or a new cycle appears
failure_modes.detection: import_cycle_inventory signal reports policy/current delta with affected modules, edges, counts, and LOC.
failure_modes.recovery: Architecture owner removes the growth before merge or returns to human-approved Design for an explicit bound change; the ratchet is never bypassed inline.

failure_modes.mode: Direct decomposition or explicit composition input changes behavior
failure_modes.detection: boundary_parity signal reports direct scan(decompose=True), Retro, context-note, graph-impact, governed-caller audit, or sparse-fallback mismatch.
failure_modes.recovery: Owning engineer restores compatibility through graph_decomposition or the named consuming parameter and reruns direct/caller/parity plus SCC checks before accepting the cut.

failure_modes.mode: Evaluation trial is missing, duplicated, corrupt, or model-mismatched
failure_modes.detection: evaluation_sample signal reports complete=false and the exact trial key/problem.
failure_modes.recovery: Evaluation runner retries only the exact missing key or starts a new sample after reconciliation; it never fills a missing row or computes a passing partial rate.

failure_modes.mode: Eval impact map is broad, escaped, unmatched, duplicate, or over bound
failure_modes.detection: evaluation_corpus_impact signal reports invalid prefix/exact-file relation, relation counts, or unrelated product/CLI/reporting impact.
failure_modes.recovery: Graph/eval owner narrows the row to canonical corpus prefix and exact tracked files within 32/128 bounds, then reruns selectivity and strict graph checks before merge.

failure_modes.mode: Seeded-failure units are duplicated, arithmetically inconsistent, or empty
failure_modes.detection: seeded_failure_catch_rate signal reports unit-identity duplicate, sample_size!=denominator, numerator bound failure, mixed identity, or unavailable zero-sample field violation.
failure_modes.recovery: Evaluation owner reconciles unique complete units and reruns projections; zero sample remains unavailable with numeric fields omitted until real units exist.

failure_modes.mode: A substantive quick finding requests promotion
failure_modes.detection: review_depth_policy signal reports correction_required with zero deep slots/expectations/leases.
failure_modes.recovery: The orchestrator returns the affected work to its owner for bounded correction in the same wave and reruns the quick sweep; no deep worker is dispatched.

signals: baseline_verification: run id, branch/SHA, graph fingerprint/scanned SHA, Plan authority state, prior Design blob digests, authoritative knowledge-root identity, pre/post manifest ids and digests, entry count, missing/moved/unexpected/empty-tree flags
enforcement_status: live|unproven|advisory, enforcement evidence id, Codex session id, verified hook-path receipt, and—only for advisory—actor/reason/scope/expiry/accepted limitations
python_compatibility: interpreter minor, exact tracked-Python-set fingerprint, closed production stage-consumer set, module/entry, compile/import/flow phase, named error, mutation snapshot digest
graph_scan_quality: degraded boolean, producer, file/resolved module/parser/error class/bounded reason, decompose mode, scanned SHA, quality fingerprint
cli_error_envelope: command, public registry fingerprint, registry/KNOWN exact-set equality, public error class, mapping id, exit class, recovery id, unexpected-exception behavior, debug availability
ci_commit_proof: fetched ref and fetch receipt, HEAD SHA, refs/remotes/origin/main SHA, checked SHA, ahead count, behind count, required check names/conclusions and receipt SHAs
import_cycle_inventory: source revision, every SCC member/internal edge, member/edge/LOC counts, before/after delta

boundary_parity: direct depgraph.scan(decompose=True), tp/loop/retro composition-root coverage, review-to-lens context-note and host-to-taskplane_lite graph-impact caller coverage, graph payload and sparse-fallback proof fingerprints
review_depth_policy: requirement/wave, quick slots, deep slots, promotion attempts, correction/block outcome
evaluation_trial: sample/scenario/trial id, observed model id/version, evaluation revision, status and immutable record fingerprint
evaluation_sample: requested/completed/distinct trials, pass count/rate, threshold, completeness and refusal reason

evaluation_corpus_impact: canonical corpus prefix, exact tracked target files, row/total relation counts, invalid/escaped/unmatched/duplicate flags, unrelated product/CLI/reporting selectivity results

seeded_failure_catch_rate: exact label, counted-unit-set fingerprint, numerator, denominator, sample size, rate, threshold, scenario set, model id/version, evaluation revision, duplicate/mixed-identity flags, availability/reason and zero-sample numeric-field omission
alerts: Block wave entry on any baseline_verification authoritative-root/manifest mismatch, empty or wrong tree, missing/moved/unexpected entry, or active stale Plan authority.
Render enforced only for enforcement_status=live; block unproven mutation and require an attributable bounded advisory receipt for any advisory exception.
Block before mutation/tests on python_compatibility failure and name the supported-range recovery.
Warn visibly in normal graph mode and block strict/readiness/review on any base-scanner or decomposition producer with graph_scan_quality degraded=true.
Block CLI acceptance on public-registry/KNOWN exact-set drift or swallowed unexpected exceptions.
Block pushed_green unless fetched HEAD, refs/remotes/origin/main, checked_sha, and every receipt SHA are equal with ahead=0 and behind=0.
Block merge on import_cycle_inventory growth, direct decomposition parity failure, missing governed composition input, or unjustified sparse fallback.
Block sample success on evaluation_sample incomplete/duplicate/mismatched trials; never schedule live sampling in ordinary CI.
Block invalid or near-catch-all evaluation_corpus_impact rows, including wildcard/package-wide targets or unrelated product/CLI/reporting impact.
Block inconsistent or duplicate seeded-failure counted units; render zero-sample unavailable with numeric fields omitted and alert on projection disagreement.
Block/return on review_depth_policy substantive quick findings and alert if any deep slot/promotion artifact exists.

rollout.strategy: Land five sequential waves, requiring the prior wave's acceptance set before the next begins. Begin from the trusted authoritative-root manifest and honest live|unproven|advisory enforcement receipt. Make the exact tracked-Python/closed-consumer gate, base-scanner degradation, public CLI registry, no-egress corpus, and fetched exact-SHA proof prerequisites before the wave-4 two-commit ratchet-before-cuts sequence. Preserve direct depgraph.scan(decompose=True) and all named composition roots while cutting cycles. Land bounded impact-map and arithmetic fixtures before trusting live repeats. Push only after local gates, then accept completion only when required checks are green for HEAD == refs/remotes/origin/main == checked_sha with ahead=behind=0. Keep all changes additive, stdlib-only, synchronous, and scoped away from wave six.
rollout.rollback: Rollback behavior within the affected wave while retaining every earlier quality floor: never delete or substitute authoritative baseline evidence, mislabel unproven/advisory enforcement as live, narrow the exact tracked-Python or closed-consumer sets, remove no-egress proof, hide base-scanner/decomposition degradation, fork the public CLI registry, remove/raise the cycle ratchet, break the direct scan API or governed input injection, broaden corpus impact mapping, relabel ahead/behind/stale CI proof, rewrite counted trial units, turn zero samples into a percentage, or permit deep promotion. Revert a wave-4 cut only if the retained ratchet and direct/caller parity pass. Disable live sampling by stopping new samples; existing immutable records remain readable. There is no destructive schema migration or external event cutover.

visualization.reason: Five ordered gates, the two-commit ratchet-before-cuts sub-sequence, cross-wave invariants, and the separate wave-six boundary are materially clearer as one accessible dependency timeline.

lens_evidence.evidence: One bounded quick sweep grounded every premise in the active baseline graph and cited repository seams, compared independent patches, five ratcheted waves, and architecture-first, and selected the smallest ordered contract approach. The correction cycle closed every substantive quick finding: trusted authoritative-root manifest identity; honest live|unproven|advisory enforcement receipts; all four lazy imports and the closed four-consumer set; exact tracked-Python compilation with an outside-directory sentinel; base-scanner degradation in both modes; fetched exact-SHA/ahead/behind proof; process-wide no-egress and repeated-byte parity; one public CLI engine-error registry; backward-compatible direct decomposition plus every named composition root/input edge; bounded selective corpus impact; and unique counted-unit catch-rate arithmetic with zero-sample omission. All 18 criteria have executable validation, each failure has a named signal and bounded owner recovery, rollback remains additive, quick-only correction has zero deep slots/promotions, and wave six remains explicitly deferred.
